sentences.text: Shri Pramod Choubey - Government Advocate for State.
Shri Nikhil Bhatt - Advocate for objector.

Order 
This is second application filed by applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Surksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.237/2024 registered at Police Station Barela, District Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 376(2)(N), 354-A, 506 of IPC.
2.

Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that earlier applicant was granted bail, but bail was cancelled by High Court when it was found that applicant was following prosecutrix and trying to influence the witnesses at Jabalpur.
It is submitted that applicant is ready to mark his presence before Police Station, Sagar and will not come Jabalpur and will not influence any witness.
In these circumstances applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of objector submitted that earlier bail was cancelled.
It is submitted that applicant may file repeat NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6168 2 MCRC-1905-2025 application after examination of prosecutrix.
4. Government Advocate appearing for State also opposed the application for grant of bail.

sentences.text: Prayer made by counsel appearing for objector appears to be reasonable.
Accordingly, application is dismissed with liberty to applicant to file repeat application after examination of prosecutrix in Court.
Trial Court is directed to examine the prosecutrix expeditiously in Court and prosecution shall make every endeavor to verify the photograph which has been sent to FSL, Bhopal.
Liberty is also extended to applicant to file repeat application after period of three months, if prosecution fails to examine prosecutrix within three months.
